setup.README.md:
# Shelf

Shelf is a small HTTP API for a neighborhood book-lending library. Members list books, borrow a book, and return it. Librarians add books.

## Run

- `npm ci`
- `npm test` runs the unit tests with the Node test runner.
- `npm run lint` runs ESLint.
- `npm start` starts the API on port 3000.

## Delivery

GitHub Actions run `npm test` and `npm run lint` on every pull request (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`). A merge to `main` deploys to the `staging` environment automatically. Deploys to `production` run by a manual dispatch of `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` and need an approved change request with a key such as `CR-42`. Issues are tracked in GitHub Issues.
setup.CONTRIBUTING.md:
# Contributing

- Work on a branch named `feat/<topic>` or `fix/<topic>` and open a pull request to `main`. Never push to `main`.
- One code owner review is required (see `.github/CODEOWNERS`).
- Never write member names or email addresses to logs. Log the member id only.
- Store and return all dates as UTC ISO-8601 strings. Loan due dates are 14 days after the borrow date.
- Every route has a unit test in `test/`.
setup..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: ci
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm test
setup..github/workflows/deploy.yml:
name: deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        type: choice
        options: [staging, production]
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: ${{ inputs.environment || 'staging' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: echo deploy
